results.title: Who is Komal Rani Swarnkar, actress spotted with Govinda at airport?
results.description: Govinda has once again found himself in the spotlight after a video of the actor with actress Komal Rani Swarnkar at the airport surfaced online. The two have been seen together at several public appearances in recent times, and their latest appearance has sparked fresh discussion on social media.

results.title: Former acting principal on the run lands in EOW net over ₹2.66 cr embezzlement in UP schools
results.description: The accused, identified as Jeet Lal Patel, former acting principal of the ATS Surwal Shahni School in Prayagraj, was arrested by an EOW Lucknow team from the Shankargarh area of Prayagraj on Monday, according to an official statement issued by the agency on Tuesday. The case pertains to alleged financial irregularities and corruption in the four government-run residential schools between the financial year 2018-19 and 2021-22.
